title: AI-powered Fragrance Discovery Platform Parfumerie Launches With 2M Pounds Pre-seed
summary: The nascent platform aims to connect personalized scent discovery to purchases through multibrand retailers, beginning in the U.K. with Selfridges, Sephora, Space NK and more.

extraction.key_fact: AI 기반 향수 탐색 플랫폼 Parfumerie가 영국에서 시작했다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: The nascent platform aims to connect personalized scent discovery to purchases through multibrand retailers, beginning in the U.K. with Selfridges, Sephora, Space NK and more.
